etymology.historical_story: Jamuan is formed from jamu, the hospitality root associated with receiving and feeding guests, plus the noun-forming suffix -an. Its two meanings preserve a useful connection: the food offered and the gathering where it is offered. Malaysian expressions such as jamuan ringan and jamuan negara show how the same word spans modest refreshments and ceremonial hospitality.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jamu 是“招待”，加 -an 把动作变成“招待用的餐点或聚餐”：jamu + an → jamuan。

etymology.historical_story: Jasad comes from Arabic jasad, meaning body. In Malay, its meanings range from the physical human body to a deceased person's remains. Scientific usage also employs it for a material body or object. These senses share one concrete idea: an embodied, physical presence, whether discussed in literature, news or physics. [Wiktionary: jasad](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/jasad)

etymology.historical_story: Jefferson is especially familiar internationally through Thomas Jefferson, the principal drafter of the American Declaration of Independence and the third United States president. His legacy also includes founding the University of Virginia and enslaving people while advocating liberty. These historical associations explain one prominent referent of the name, but do not identify every person called Jefferson. [Source: Monticello](https://www.monticello.org/biography-of-jefferson).

morphology.pattern_note: 词首 j 读 /dʒ/，首音节 e 为央元音 /ə/，词尾 k 在所列马来西亚读音中实现为喉塞音 /ʔ/。meN- 接 j 时形成 men-，保留 j：meN- + jeruk → menjeruk。

word_family.gloss: 用酸、盐等腌制；menjeruk rasa 比喻把痛苦情绪闷在心里

senses.zh_definition: 腌制食品；用酸液、盐等腌制的水果、蔬菜、蛋或鱼等，在马来西亚日常饮食语境中常指酸甜腌水果。
senses.en_definition: Pickled or preserved food, especially fruit, prepared using acid, salt, or similar preserving ingredients.
senses.ms_definition: Makanan seperti buah, sayur, telur atau ikan yang diawet dengan cara diasamkan atau diasinkan.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚常见的是腌芒果等食品，但本义不限于水果，也不保证每一种都加糖或经过发酵。参见 [DBP jeruk 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=jeruk)。

senses.zh_definition: 腌制的；以酸或盐处理并保存的，修饰水果、蔬菜、鱼等食品。
senses.en_definition: Pickled or preserved by treatment with acid or salt.
senses.ms_definition: Yang telah diawet melalui pengasaman atau pengasinan, khususnya makanan.
senses.nuances: 通常后置修饰食品名称，如 mangga jeruk。与名词义关系紧密，区别在于这里描述食品的处理状态。依据见 [DBP《学生词典》释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=jeruk)。

senses.ms_definition: Buah limau; penggunaan bahasa Indonesia yang turut dicatatkan dalam kamus bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: DBP 以 Id 标注这一义项。在马来西亚谈论新鲜柑橘、青柠等时，通常使用 limau；不能把 jeruk nipis 按字面误解为腌制青柠。参见 [DBP jeruk 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=jeruk)。

collocations.zh: 青柠；马来西亚通常称 limau nipis

senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 另列的 jeruk II，标注 Kl，常见于 basah jeruk 或 jeruk wok 等方言表达；不宜当作全国通用的正式表达。下列搭配属于地域搭配。参见 [DBP jeruk II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=jeruk+II)。

etymology.historical_story: Jeruk offers a useful glimpse of culinary vocabulary across the Malay world. DBP records preserved foods as a central meaning, but also labels the citrus meaning as Indonesian usage. Its derived expression menjeruk rasa evokes feelings kept painfully inside. These connections are documented meanings and imagery, rather than proof of a particular ancient origin. [DBP dictionary entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=jeruk)

senses.zh_definition: 节俭的；在花钱或使用资源方面不浪费、用量少的。

senses.zh_definition: 谨慎的；做事留心、有所防备的。
senses.en_definition: Careful or circumspect in one's actions.
senses.ms_definition: Berhati-hati dan beringat-ingat ketika melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这个较宽泛的义项多见于传统表达；现代日常交流通常用 berhati-hati。谚语里的 jimat 同时包含节用和预先防备的意思。

collocations.en: be prudent before supplies run out

senses.nuances: 这是独立的同形词 jimat II，不是“节俭”义的引申。马来西亚日常表达此义通常用 azimat 或 tangkal。DBP 将其转释为 azimat。参见 [DBP：jimat II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=jimat+II)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two separate words spelled jimat: thrift or carefulness, and an amulet. The proverb ingat sebelum kena, jimat sebelum habis connects prudent living with acting before trouble arrives. This cultural association explains the familiar advice, but the dictionary evidence alone does not establish the thrift word's ultimate borrowing history. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=jimat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ji.mat，记成“积一点，慢点花”：少浪费就是 jimat。护身符义另记为 azimat 的同义词，不与省钱混为一谈。

morphology.pattern_note: 资料包未确定词项身份、语言来源或读音，因此音节、IPA 和 Jawi 保留 null。若确指英语人名 Joan，常见英式读音为 /dʒəʊn/，但不能据此认定原始词项的读音。[Cambridge 人名发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/joan)

senses.zh_definition: 若指 Joan：人名，英语女性名常译“琼”；原始小写词项 joan 的具体身份尚未确定。

etymology.historical_story: If the token represents the English name Joan, its history belongs to European personal naming rather than Malay word formation. Medieval records connect the feminine name with Joanna and John, ultimately with a Hebrew name associated with divine favour. That history explains a possible name, but does not identify the unexplained lowercase token in this packet. [Medieval names dictionary](https://dmnes.org/name/Joan)

senses.nuances: 这是输入所载的核心义。可用于各种水果果酱；kaya 通常指另一类以蛋和椰浆制成的甜酱，不能一概与 jem 互换。马来语释义据 DBP 改写，并非逐字引文。参见 [PRPM：jem](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=jem)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay jem corresponds to English jam, with spelling that represents its Malay pronunciation. Its meanings offer a useful contrast: fruit cooked into a spread, and, informally, vehicles packed into congestion. DBP records the food meaning and gives jem as a colloquial equivalent of traffic jam. Context normally makes the intended meaning clear. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=jem).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jem 对应英语 jam：抹在面包上是果酱，挤在公路上是堵车；看搭配就能分清。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此是附着成分，可回指已知对象，表示其距离；不一定译成人称所有格。按给定分类归入 suffix。词根无拼写变化，音节末 k 常实现为 [ʔ]。headword.jawi 保留输入的词根写法 جارق；完整词形为 جارقڽ。缺失的音节信息据词形补全。

etymology.historical_story: Jaraknya combines the distance noun jarak with the attached form -nya. The dictionary records both ordinary separation and an older mathematical meaning, radius. A useful historical lesson lies in that contrast: older texts may describe a circle differently from a modern classroom, where jari-jari is the familiar term for radius. [DBP: jarak I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=jarak+I)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ja-rak 时把双手拉开，记住“距离”；再接 nya，回指刚提到的地点：jaraknya＝那个地点的距离。

morphology.pattern_note: jawap 是与 jawab 对应的变体，不能把词尾 p 当成后缀。词族按通行词根 jawab 归并，不据 jawap 生造派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 回答问题、回应呼唤或作出答复；为 jawab 的变体。
senses.en_definition: To answer or reply; a variant of jawab.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan balasan terhadap pertanyaan atau menyahut panggilan; varian bagi jawab.
senses.nuances: DBP 于2017年12月19日的咨询答复明确接受 jawap 与 jawab 为变体，并指出 jawab 在构词上更准确。本条 official 表示有官方接受依据，不表示其为首选拼写。正式编辑宜统一使用 jawab、menjawab。参见 [DBP 语言咨询答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penggunaannya)。以下 jawap 搭配展示变体用法，其首选形式分别为 jawab soalan、jawab panggilan；未据此声称变体搭配的语料频率。

senses.zh_definition: 针对问题或呼唤作出的回答、应答；为 jawab 的变体。
senses.en_definition: An answer or response; a variant of jawab.
senses.ms_definition: Balasan yang diberikan apabila ditanya atau dipanggil; varian bagi jawab.
senses.nuances: 日常表达“答案”通常采用 jawapan；固定表达和正式标题宜采用 soal jawab、sesi soal jawab。此处意义依据 [DBP 的 jawab 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=234664&keyword=jawab)，不另立一个与 jawab 无关的新义。

etymology.historical_story: The relationship between jawap and jawab illustrates how familiar usage and morphological regularity can coexist. In a language advisory dated 19 December 2017, DBP accepted both as variants while identifying jawab as morphologically preferable. Learners can therefore recognize jawap in use while organizing related forms such as menjawab and jawapan under jawab.

etymology.historical_story: Jiwaku is a transparent Malay possessive construction rather than a separate historical root: jiwa plus the attached pronoun -ku. Jiwa belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary of life and spirit, associated with jīva. Malay usage also extends the word to inner feelings and a beloved person, making jiwaku especially expressive in poetry and intimate address. Sources: [Wikikamus](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/jiwa), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=jiwa).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jiwa 是心灵，-ku 是“我的”：jiwa + ku，一步记成“我的心灵”。

etymology.historical_story: Jib belongs to the international vocabulary of sailing, and Malay uses it for the triangular forward sail. Malaysian naval writing uses the same term when introducing sailboat components. English dictionaries describe the sail word’s deeper origin as uncertain, so a specific Dutch or other source should not be asserted without additional evidence. [Royal Malaysian Navy](https://pusmas.navy.mil.my/images/pdf/Majalah%20Samudera/2003/Edisi_3_2023.pdf), [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/jib)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着于名词后的代词性附着成分，可表示第三人称所属或回指已知事物；拼写连写，ny 表示 /ɲ/。这里的 root_word 保留输入所给的直接构词基础 jawaban，最终词根为 jawab。

word_family.gloss: 答案；答复，马来西亚更常用的变体

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的答复；前文所指的人或机构给出的回应。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its reply; the response of a previously mentioned person or organization.
senses.ms_definition: Balasan atau respons daripada seseorang atau sesuatu pihak yang telah disebut, dengan -nya merujuk pihak tersebut.
senses.nuances: 不是动词“他回答”，而是带 -nya 的名词。-nya 的具体所指须由上下文判断。DBP 接受 jawaban 与 jawapan 为同义变体，马来西亚通常更常用 jawapan，因此 jawabannya 常可换为 jawapannya。[DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=jawaban)

senses.zh_definition: 该问题的答案或解答；某人作出的答案，尤其指书面作答。

senses.ms_definition: Penyelesaian bagi soalan atau masalah tertentu, atau hasil jawaban seseorang, terutama dalam bentuk tulisan.
senses.nuances: -nya 可回指题目，也可指作答者，因此 jawabannya betul 既可表示“答案是对的”，也可表示“他或她答对了”，须依语境解释。

etymology.historical_story: Jawabannya preserves a useful contrast within the Malay language world: jawaban follows the transparent combination jawab plus -an, while jawapan is the more familiar Malaysian variant. DBP accepts both forms. Adding -nya links the answer to someone or something already mentioned. The word therefore illustrates how shared vocabulary can retain different regional preferences without changing its central meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先听出 jawab“回答”，再把 -an 看成“回答的结果”，最后用 -nya 接上“他的／那个”：jawabannya＝他的答复／那个答案。

senses.zh_definition: 烟炱；燃烧产生的黑色细微颗粒，存在于烟中或沉积在物体表面形成烟黑。

etymology.historical_story: Jelaga evokes the household world of smoky lamps and cooking fires: smoke leaves a fine black coating on nearby surfaces. DBP preserves arang lampu and arang para as alternative names, connecting the word with familiar objects and places. These associations explain its cultural setting, but do not establish an earlier linguistic origin. [DBP reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=jelaga)

etymology.historical_story: English June developed through French forms from Latin Iunius. Its name is commonly connected with Juno, the Roman goddess, although that ancient derivation is not certain. The month name later also became a personal name. For Malay learners, the practical distinction is spelling: the month is Jun in Malay, while a person named June retains that spelling. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/June).

etymology.historical_story: An early Malay dictionary records jadah as Persian in origin, associated with being born or being someone's offspring, but already used disparagingly in Malay. In haram jadah, an expression about birth became a powerful insult, and modern angry questions can use jadah without making any literal claim about ancestry. etymology.historical_story: Jag is a Malay borrowing of English jug. An early English–Malay vocabulary records Jag as a name used for the European jug in the Straits Settlements, offering a glimpse of language contact through household objects. Modern DBP terminology also pairs English jug with Malay jag. The familiar serving vessel thus carries a small trace of everyday multilingual exchange.

etymology.historical_story: Country names can preserve differences between closely related national languages. Indonesian uses Jepang, while Malaysian Malay uses Jepun. Readers encounter both through books, films, news, and regional travel. This entry records that cultural and linguistic distinction without claiming a particular ancient pronunciation or borrowing route, which the supplied packet does not document.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把国家名成对记：印度尼西亚语 Jepang，马来西亚马来语 Jepun；两个都指“日本”。

etymology.historical_story: Jump is identifiable here as an English word, not as a verified Malay headword. English interface labels can be quoted inside Malay conversation, as the gaming example illustrates. Such use explains a possible context for the spelling without establishing an official borrowing. The packet provides no evidence for a separate Malay origin or for interpreting it as jumpa.

etymology.historical_story: Jejak names a footprint or trace. Its derived verb carries a concrete image: someone follows marks left by feet. DBP also records investigation as a figurative meaning of menjejaki. The same connection helps explain present uses involving parcels, transactions and historical origins. This is a documented relationship between meanings, not a claim about the word's first appearance. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=menjejaki)

etymology.historical_story: Malay jip adapts English jeep to Malay spelling. The vehicle became internationally familiar through military use during the Second World War and later civilian use. The deeper origin of the English name remains disputed: explanations involving the letters GP and the comic character Eugene the Jeep should be presented as theories rather than settled fact. [Source: Jeep history](https://www.jeep.ca/en/articles/the-birth-of-the-jeep-name).

word_family.gloss: 动作不连贯、忽顿忽动的；此处不是肉干义

senses.zh_definition: 短促而突然的一次拉动、震动或抽动，也可指肌肉不自主的抽动。
senses.en_definition: A short, abrupt movement, pull, or muscular twitch.
senses.ms_definition: Sentakan atau gerakan singkat yang berlaku secara tiba-tiba, termasuk kedutan otot.
senses.nuances: 这是英语名词；马来语通常依语境用 sentakan、sentapan 或 kedutan。以下搭配提供对应的马来语表达。参见 [DBP：jerk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=jerk)。

senses.zh_definition: 突然猛拉、猛推或扭动；身体或物体突然抽动、顿挫。
senses.en_definition: To move abruptly or cause something to move with a sudden pull, push, or twist.
senses.ms_definition: Menyentak atau menyentap sesuatu; bergerak secara tersentak-sentak.
senses.nuances: 英语中既可及物，也可不及物。马来语须区分主动的 menyentak 与表示物体发生动作的 tersentak；通常比 goyangkan 更突然、更短促。

senses.zh_definition: 举止讨厌、粗鲁、自私或愚蠢的人；带贬义的骂人用语。
senses.en_definition: An annoyingly rude, selfish, or foolish person.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang menjengkelkan kerana bersikap biadab, mementingkan diri atau bodoh.
senses.nuances: 属于英语非正式贬称；马来西亚双语交流可能夹用。具体贬义依行为而定，不宜一律译成同一个中文脏话。

senses.zh_definition: 举重挺举的上挺阶段：将肩前的杠铃迅速举至头顶并伸直手臂。
senses.en_definition: The overhead phase of a clean and jerk, lifting the bar from the shoulders to arm's length.
senses.ms_definition: Fasa mengangkat barbel dari bahu ke atas kepala sehingga lengan diluruskan dalam angkatan clean and jerk.
senses.nuances: 体育专门义。clean and jerk 整体通常称为挺举；单独的 jerk 指后半段上挺动作。参见 [Cambridge：jerk](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/jerk)。

senses.zh_definition: 牙买加式香辣腌烤食品；也可前置修饰食材或调味料，表示这种烹饪风味。
senses.en_definition: Jamaican-style spiced and barbecued food, also used before food and seasoning names.
senses.ms_definition: Hidangan gaya Jamaica yang diperap dengan rempah lalu dipanggang, serta nama gaya perasaannya.
senses.nuances: 餐饮义与突然抽动及骂人义不同；jerk chicken 中 jerk 可作名词前置修饰语。参见 [Merriam-Webster：jerk](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/jerk)。

etymology.historical_story: English jerk has separate historical strands. The movement verb may be an expressive variant of yerk, an older word for striking or lashing. The culinary word belongs to a different history involving preserved meat and forms associated with Spanish charqui and Quechua. These origins should not be merged into a Malay root story. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/jerk)。

etymology.historical_story: An 1852 Malay dictionary records juru for a skilled artisan or master and lists occupational combinations, including an interpreter and a helmsman. Modern Malay continues this productive pattern in professional titles. This documents continuity in usage without requiring an unsupported claim about the word's ultimate origin. [Crawfurd's dictionary](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Janjinya is formed transparently from janji and the attached pronoun -nya. Malay dictionaries preserve a wider semantic range for janji than everyday English promise: conditions, deferred time, and even one's appointed death. This helps explain literary expressions about a person's time having come, without treating janjinya as an unrelated word.

etymology.historical_story: Jantungku combines the Malay noun jantung with ku, the shortened form of aku. Its cultural resonance comes from the heart as both a bodily organ and an image of someone precious. Malay also uses jantung hati for a dearly loved person. The attached pronoun makes the expression personal: the heart, literally or poetically, belongs to the speaker.

etymology.historical_story: Juárez is a Spanish-language surname rather than a Malay descriptive word. A well-documented naming story concerns Ciudad Juárez: the city previously known as Paso del Norte received its present name in 1888 in honour of Benito Juárez. This explains that city’s commemorative name without requiring an uncertain account of the surname’s deeper linguistic ancestry. [Source: Juárez municipal government](https://www.juarez.gob.mx/noticia/3733/la-construccin-del-monumento-a-benito-jurez).

etymology.historical_story: The spelling Jiang illustrates how romanization can conceal distinctions preserved in Chinese characters. 江 and 姜 are read jiāng, while 蔣 is read jiǎng; all can appear without tone marks in names. Consequently, the spelling alone cannot identify a family history, a source character, or the origin of this particular token.

etymology.historical_story: Jerami belongs to an old Austronesian word family associated with rice straw. The reconstructed form *zaRami connects Malay with related words across island Southeast Asia. Its history reflects the long familiarity of these communities with harvested stalks, while Malay also applies the word to the fibrous material surrounding jackfruit flesh. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-s_z.htm)

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于词尾的强调小品词，并非派生后缀；此处 suffix 仅表示附着位置。词根读音不变。输入 Jawi جوجور 对应 jujur，未包含 -lah。

senses.zh_definition: 诚实、真诚；加上 -lah 后通常表示“请坦诚些”“就说实话吧”，或强调诚实的态度。

senses.ms_definition: Lurus hati, tulus dan ikhlas, dengan penegasan melalui partikel -lah; lazim digunakan untuk menyeru seseorang supaya berkata benar.
senses.nuances: 词类仍以 jujur 的形容词性质为基础，整句可具有劝告或请求功能。不是引出自己坦白话的固定副词“老实说”；后者通常用 sejujurnya。-lah 可缓和请求，也可加强催促，须结合语调判断。[DBP：-lah 的强调与祈使功能](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel)。

etymology.historical_story: The expression combines the moral adjective jujur with the Malay emphasis particle -lah. Its cultural interest lies in how a description becomes an appeal: honesty is presented as something the listener should practise now. Malay grammar treats -lah as a particle rather than a derivational suffix, so the expression does not introduce a separate lexical root.

etymology.historical_story: Jahanam comes from Arabic Jahannam, the name for hell. Malay usage extends beyond its religious reference to a wicked person and to something utterly ruined. Jahanamlah adds the Malay emphatic particle -lah to that established word. Its force depends on context: it can express dismay about destruction or form part of a hostile curse. [Word origin](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/jahanam), [Malay meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1/Cari1/Cari1/cari1/cari1?keyword=jahanam).

senses.zh_definition: 哎呀；天哪；真是的。用于表达惊讶、懊恼、不耐烦或轻微责怪的英语感叹词。
senses.en_definition: An informal English exclamation expressing surprise, annoyance, frustration, or exasperation.
senses.ms_definition: Kata seru bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan untuk melahirkan rasa terkejut, geram, kecewa atau tidak sabar.
senses.nuances: 实际词类是感叹词，即 kata seru；此处归入 particle。它可出现在马来语与英语夹杂的聊天中，但不宜当作正式马来语表达教授。语气取决于声调：可表示惊讶，也可暗含责怪；另有拼法 geez。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/jeez)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报：说明引语中的英语感叹词
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam laporan tersebut, ungkapan bahasa Inggeris 'jeez' dipetik untuk menggambarkan rasa kecewa penutur.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该报告引用英语感叹词“jeez”，以呈现说话者的失望情绪。
dual_scenarios.en: The report quotes the English expression 'jeez' to convey the speaker's frustration.

dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
kat sini 对应标准语 di sini。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语场合应按具体意思改用中性完整句。由于词源涉及 Jesus，面对重视宗教措辞的人，应避免随意用它发泄情绪。

etymology.historical_story: Recorded in English in the 1920s, jeez developed as a softened shortening of Jesus. Speakers could express surprise or irritation while avoiding the full religious name. That history explains why an apparently mild exclamation can still carry religious associations. In Malay conversation, it belongs to English code-switching rather than native Malay word formation. Sources: [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/jeez), [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/jeez).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /dʒiːz/ 想成拖长的一声“真——是的！”；记住它表达情绪，不指具体事物。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借入，不作马来语词缀拆分；末尾 -s 不是马来语复数词缀。所列音标对应英语原词；马来语规范拼写 jean，读作 /dʒin/。

word_family.gloss: 牛仔裤；马来语规范词形

senses.zh_definition: 牛仔裤；通常用厚实、耐磨的牛仔布制成的休闲长裤。
senses.en_definition: Casual trousers made from denim or a similar hard-wearing fabric.
senses.ms_definition: Seluar panjang daripada denim atau kain tebal yang tahan lasak, biasanya dipakai sebagai pakaian kasual.
senses.nuances: jeans 是英语词形，常见于日常交流、商品名称和混合语言表达；规范马来文采用 jean。布料本身通常称 denim，不能把所有牛仔布制品都称作 jeans。一条牛仔裤可说 sehelai seluar jean，不需要通过英语 -s 表示马来语复数。[DBP：jean](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=jean)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合购物、穿搭和休闲活动话题。出席面试、典礼或进入有服装要求的场所时，应按邀请或场所规定选择衣着；牛仔裤是否合适取决于具体活动。

etymology.historical_story: English jeans developed from jean, a fabric name associated with Genoa, Italy, through the city's French name. Trousers made from that fabric became known as jean pants. Modern jeans are generally made from denim. The familiar English clothing term also appears in Malaysian usage, while Malay dictionaries record jean. [Sources: FIDM Museum](https://asufidmmuseum.asu.edu/learn/articles/blue-jeans), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=jean).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 jeans，就想象一条牛仔裤；写规范马来文时记住 jean，读音接近“金”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + jenius → jenius（印尼语形式；马来西亚规范形式：genius）
morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，不能拆成马来语词缀。音标按印尼语形式说明；马来西亚规范词 genius 的首音为 /ɡ/。词族列规范马来语对应词及其派生词，不表示它们由 jenius 直接加缀形成。

word_family.gloss: 马来西亚规范形式：极聪明的；天才

senses.zh_definition: 极其聪明的；具有非凡智力或创造才能的。jenius 为印尼语形式，马来西亚规范马来语写作 genius。
senses.en_definition: Exceptionally intelligent or gifted; an Indonesian form corresponding to Malaysian Malay genius.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat cerdik atau mempunyai kebolehan intelektual yang luar biasa; bentuk baku bahasa Melayu Malaysia ialah genius.
senses.nuances: 不可把 jenius 标为马来西亚规范拼写。DBP 收录 genius，并明确保留该拼写。以下搭配展示印尼语形式，括号内给出马来西亚规范对应形式；例句中的 jenius 作为被讨论的拼写出现。[DBP：genius](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=genius)；[印尼语词条](https://baru.kbbi.co.id/arti-kata/jenius)

collocations.ms: anak jenius（印尼语；马来西亚：anak genius）
pemikiran jenius（印尼语；马来西亚：pemikiran genius）

dual_scenarios.en: For publication in Malaysia, the editor changed the spelling "jenius" to "genius" in the manuscript.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 马来西亚学校作业、公文及正式出版物使用 genius。引用印尼语原文或保留专名时，可保留 jenius，不宜把地域差异简单说成对方不会拼写。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称赞别人 genius 通常是高度赞扬，但配合反问或挖苦语气也可能成为讽刺。纠正 jenius 的拼写时，说明地域规范即可。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 马来西亚学校作业、公文及正式出版物使用 genius。引用印尼语原文或保留专名时，可保留 jenius，不宜把地域差异简单说成对方不会拼写。

etymology.historical_story: The international word family goes back to Latin genius, originally associated with a guardian spirit and natural disposition. Its meanings later developed toward remarkable talent and intelligence. Indonesian uses jenius, while Malaysian Malay retains genius. This spelling difference matters because closely related languages do not always standardize borrowed words in the same way. [Word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/genius); [DBP spelling guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=genius)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住地域开关：印尼 jenius，马来西亚 genius；在马来西亚写作时保留开头 g。

morphology.formula: ∅ + job → job（英语整词用于语码转换）
morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，不拆成马来语词缀。所列 IPA 是英语参考读音，马来西亚实际读音可有差异。词包的 syllables 值 various translations 不是音节划分，已改为单音节 job。

senses.zh_definition: 工作；职位。马来语非正式交谈中夹用的英语词。
senses.en_definition: A paid position or employment, expressed through English code-switching in Malay conversation.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan dalam percakapan bercampur bahasa untuk merujuk pekerjaan atau jawatan.
senses.nuances: 此处说明英语词在马来语交谈中的用法，不据此认定其为规范马来语词头。正式表达依语境使用 pekerjaan、jawatan 或 kerja。DBP 将英语 job 对应为 kerja、tugas 等：[DBP 术语对照](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kerja)。以下为常见口语组合，未提供语料频率排名。

senses.zh_definition: 一项任务；一单有偿工作，尤指自由职业或短期承接的活。
senses.en_definition: A particular task or paid assignment, especially a freelance or short-term engagement.
senses.ms_definition: Tugasan tertentu atau kerja berbayar yang diterima, khususnya secara bebas atau untuk tempoh yang singkat.
senses.nuances: 例如摄影、设计或活动工作的一单委托，不一定表示长期雇佣关系。正式文件可按实际关系使用 tugasan、tempahan kerja 或 projek。马来文释义为编写释义，并非声称来自缺失的 DBP 马来语词头。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 翻译用语说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam iklan jawatan bahasa Melayu, istilah bahasa Inggeris job boleh diterjemahkan sebagai pekerjaan atau jawatan mengikut konteks.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在马来语招聘广告中，英语 job 可依语境译为 pekerjaan 或 jawatan。
dual_scenarios.en: In Malay recruitment advertisements, the English term job can be translated as pekerjaan or jawatan, depending on context.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 自由摄影师讨论接单

dual_scenarios.zh: 我接到这周末的一单摄影活了。
dual_scenarios.en: I've landed a photography gig for this weekend.
spoken_features: job 是夹用的英语词。
dah 对应 sudah。
ni 对应 ini。
aku 适用于熟人关系，正式场合通常改用 saya。

messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah mendapat tugasan fotografi pada hujung minggu ini. Awak hendak ikut serta?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: job 本身不粗俗，熟人及部分职场团队的混合语言交流中可自然出现。正式公文、招聘文本或面向广泛公众的说明宜使用合适的马来语对应词。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈到自由职业时，确认 job 指单次委托还是长期职位，避免误解雇佣关系。与不习惯英语夹杂的听众交流时，用 kerja 或具体马来语词更清楚。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: job 本身不粗俗，熟人及部分职场团队的混合语言交流中可自然出现。正式公文、招聘文本或面向广泛公众的说明宜使用合适的马来语对应词。

etymology.historical_story: Here job is the English word used inside a Malay conversation. It can name either regular employment or an individual assignment, so context determines the appropriate Malay equivalent. DBP terminology supplies equivalents such as kerja and tugas. The supplied packet does not establish when this conversational usage began, and no separate Malay historical origin should be invented for it.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cari job 是“找工作”，ambil job 是“接活”；正式写作再按语境换成 pekerjaan、jawatan 或 tugasan。

morphology.pattern_note: 首音节 je- 的 e 读 /ə/。meN-、peN- 接 j 时分别表现为 men-、pen-，保留 j，形成 menjelajah、penjelajah。

word_family.gloss: 解释；阐明；米南加保用法

senses.zh_definition: 到各处游历或探索；在某一地区广泛行走、访问或考察。
senses.en_definition: To travel widely through places or an area to explore, investigate, or experience them.
senses.ms_definition: Pergi ke pelbagai tempat atau mengelilingi sesuatu kawasan untuk menyelidik, mengembara atau melancong.
senses.nuances: 正式完整句中常用 menjelajah 或带地点宾语的 menjelajahi；口语、祈使句和宣传语常用原形 jelajah。探索可以出于研究或旅游目的，不必含危险探险之意。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=jelajah)

senses.zh_definition: 巡游或巡回活动；依次到多个地点开展的访问、宣传、演出或推广行程。
senses.en_definition: A tour or organized series of visits or events held at different locations.
senses.ms_definition: Lawatan atau rangkaian kegiatan yang dijalankan secara berperingkat di beberapa tempat.
senses.nuances: 这是当代活动名称和宣传语中常见的名词用法，如 jelajah buku、jelajah promosi。含义比特指巡回宣传或演出的 jerayawara 更宽，不是所有 jelajah 都属于宣传活动。[DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=jelajah)

senses.zh_definition: 解释、阐明或详细说明；米南加保用法，见派生形式 menjelajahkan。
senses.en_definition: To explain or expound, in Minangkabau usage, occurring as menjelajahkan.
senses.ms_definition: Menerangkan atau menghuraikan sesuatu; penggunaan Minangkabau dalam bentuk menjelajahkan.
senses.nuances: DBP 将此义另列为 jelajah II，并标注 Mn。它不是现代马来西亚标准语中“探索”义的常规使动用法。下列为说明搭配，不代表高频表达；一般交流宜用 menerangkan 或 menghuraikan。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=jelajah)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 邀请朋友可说 Jom jelajah…；正式汇报宜用 program jelajah、menjelajah 或 menjelajahi，并交代地点与目的。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于旅游、考察、巡回活动及探索主题。不要把旅游或文化访问随意说成 menjajah：该词在现代常指殖民统治，可能引起完全不同的联想。

etymology.historical_story: Jelajah brings together travel and discovery in Malay usage. Its dictionary family stretches from menjelajah, travelling through places, to penjelajah, an explorer, and penjelajahan, exploration itself. Contemporary event names extend that travelling image to touring programmes and book promotions. A separate Minangkabau sense means explaining, so identical spelling does not always imply the same meaning. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=jelajah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 跟着 je-la-jah 三个音节想象走过三个地点：一路走、一路看，就是“游历、探索”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接词基 jatuhkan；最终词根是 jatuh。-kan 表使动，-nya 在此通常是第三人称宾语附着语，不是使动词缀。ny 表示 /ɲ/，词基不发生音变。

senses.zh_definition: 使它或他掉落、倒下；把它弄掉或放落。
senses.en_definition: Cause it or him to fall; drop or knock it down.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan benda atau orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya jatuh.
senses.nuances: 常用于祈使句或禁止句，如 jangan jatuhkannya。-nya 指上下文已提及的人或物，并不表示动作由‘他’执行。普通主动陈述通常使用 menjatuhkannya，被动形式则是 dijatuhkannya。各义项依据词基释义综合改写，非词典逐字引文。参见 [DBP：menjatuhkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menjatuhkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 使其价格、价值、地位或名誉降低、受损。
senses.en_definition: Lower its value or damage the standing or reputation of its referent.
senses.ms_definition: Merosotkan nilai, kedudukan atau nama baik sesuatu atau seseorang yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 必须由上下文确定 -nya 的指称。以下列出完整主动形式的常用搭配，便于识别该义；不能在已有宾语后再重复添加同指的 -nya。

senses.zh_definition: 使其败北、失势或垮台；也可指使其陷入经济困境。
senses.en_definition: Bring about its or someone's defeat, downfall or ruin.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalahkan, menumbangkan atau menyebabkan kemerosotan keadaan pihak yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 可用于比赛、政治或事业语境。jatuhkannya 常有命令色彩；正式叙述通常需要 menjatuhkannya。以下为该义的常用完整搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 宣判或施加已提及的刑罚、罚款等。
senses.en_definition: Impose or pronounce the previously mentioned sentence or penalty.
senses.ms_definition: Mengenakan hukuman atau denda yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 只有当 -nya 指刑罚或罚款时才成立，不能据此把人直接解释为‘被判刑者’。实际法律叙述更常见 menjatuhkan hukuman；对人判刑用 menjatuhi seseorang hukuman。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈人时可能表示击倒、打压或使其垮台，语气较强。讨论表现或工作问题时，应明确具体行为，避免把 jatuhkan seseorang 当作中性批评。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Jangan jatuhkannya 是直接提醒，适合保护物品或及时制止危险。对顾客或长辈可先说 sila berhati-hati，并说明物品易碎。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈人时可能表示击倒、打压或使其垮台，语气较强。讨论表现或工作问题时，应明确具体行为，避免把 jatuhkan seseorang 当作中性批评。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical. Malay jatuh describes falling, while -kan lets a speaker describe causing a fall. Adding -nya identifies an already mentioned person or thing. The same downward image extends into public life: prices fall, reputations suffer, and governments lose power. This explains the connected senses without requiring an invented borrowing history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jatuh＝掉；-kan＝让它发生；-nya＝它或他：jatuhkannya＝‘让它掉下来’。

morphology.pattern_note: 本包对应古语形容词 jelah I，整词记忆；词尾 lah 不是附加的语气词。原包未区分字母 e 的音值，因此不将其直接转写为已核实的 IPA。

senses.zh_definition: 明亮的；清澈、清明或视野开阔清晰的。古语。
senses.en_definition: Archaic: bright, clear, limpid, or affording a clear view.
senses.ms_definition: Cerah, banglas, jernih, terang.
senses.nuances: DBP 标注 ark，即古语，不宜包装成现代高频口语。以下搭配是依据词义编写的示例，未证实为高频搭配。同页 jelah II 见于 menjelah“用黏胶或网捕鸟”，属于不同词条，不并入本包词义；聊天中连写的 je lah 也须另行判断。参见 [Kamus Dewan／PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=jelah)。

dual_scenarios.en: In this annotated edition, the archaic word “jelah” is glossed as “bright, clear, limpid, or affording a clear view”.

messages.en: Yes, it can also mean “clear” or “bright”. It’s archaic, though; these days we usually say “cerah” or “jernih”.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 此词没有固有的冒犯意味，但现代听者可能不熟悉。文学讲解时可保留并解释；日常沟通宜按语境使用 cerah、jernih 或 terang。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合古语释义、文学赏析及有意采用古雅语汇的写作。不能仅凭聊天中的连写形式 jelah，就认定说话者在使用这个古语形容词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 此词没有固有的冒犯意味，但现代听者可能不熟悉。文学讲解时可保留并解释；日常沟通宜按语境使用 cerah、jernih 或 terang。

etymology.historical_story: Jelah offers a glimpse of vocabulary preserved by dictionaries after becoming uncommon in everyday speech. Kamus Dewan labels this adjective archaic and explains it through words for brightness and clarity. The supplied material does not establish its deeper origin. Its spelling must also be distinguished from the conversational sequence je lah, which performs a different grammatical function. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=jelah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jelah 和“清亮”这幅画面连起来：天空明朗，水面清澈。整词记忆，不拆成 je + lah。

headword.verification_note: 马来西亚精武总会资料使用 Jingwu 和 Chin Woo 指称精武组织传统，但数据包不足以锁定具体组织。未确认统一的马来语读音或爪夷文写法，不补造相关字段。排名仅沿用数据包。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Jingwu → Jingwu（汉语专名整体转写）
morphology.pattern_note: 沿用数据包的根词标记；Jingwu 不按马来语词缀拆分。jing 和 wu 对应汉语名称中的字音，不是马来语词根与词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 精武：用于精武体育会及相关武术、体育和文化组织传统的名称；具体所指依上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Jingwu, a name associated with the Chin Woo tradition of martial arts, athletic associations, and cultural activities.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang merujuk kepada tradisi persatuan Chin Woo serta kegiatan seni bela diri, sukan dan kebudayaan yang berkaitan dengannya.
senses.nuances: 这是专名用法，不能把 jingwu 当作马来语中“武术”的普通词；一般“武术”可用 seni bela diri。Jingwu 与 Chin Woo 在相关组织资料中均有出现，但具体会名应依该组织正式写法。马来文释义为编辑撰写，并非 DBP 原文；以下搭配为教学示例，未经频率统计。

etymology.historical_story: Jingwu represents the Chinese name 精武, also encountered in Malaysia as Chin Woo. The movement developed in Shanghai in 1910 around Huo Yuanjia and his associates. It later spread to Southeast Asia, where associations combined martial arts with physical education and cultural activities. The name therefore carries an institutional heritage rather than a Malay affix structure.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Jingwu 直接连到“精武”：看到名称，就想到精武体育会及其武术文化活动，不把它记成所有武术的通称。

morphology.pattern_note: jelaskan 是输入指定的直接词基，jelas 是词根。-kan 是派生后缀；-nya 在此是附着代词，通常回指已提及的对象，并非时态或普通话式语气词。读音中 ny 为 /ɲ/，前面的 /n/ 仍属于 -kan。

senses.zh_definition: 把它解释清楚；对前文提到的事情加以说明。单独作请求或命令时，意为“请把这件事解释清楚”。
senses.en_definition: Explain or clarify it, referring to something already mentioned; as an imperative, explain it.
senses.ms_definition: Menerangkan atau menghuraikan perkara yang telah disebut supaya maksudnya menjadi jelas.
senses.nuances: 这是 jelaskan 与附着代词 -nya 组成的语法形式，并非新增独立词根。可用于请求，如 Sila jelaskannya，也可出现在第一人称结构中，如 Akan saya jelaskannya。普通主动陈述通常用 menjelaskannya。此处 official 表示采用标准构词，不表示 DBP 将完整字形另立词头。[DBP：menjelaskan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=menjelaskan)

senses.zh_definition: 把它结清、办妥或完成；所指通常是前文提及的债务、款项或事务。
senses.en_definition: Settle, pay off or complete it, referring to a previously mentioned debt, payment or task.
senses.ms_definition: Melunaskan hutang atau bayaran, atau menyelesaikan pekerjaan yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 承接 menjelaskan 的“结清、完成”义。必须由前文确定对象，不能看到 jelaskannya 就一律译作“解释它”。若要明确表达结清，可使用 lunaskannya 或 selesaikannya。[DBP：jelas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=jelas)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: -nya 所指须在上下文中明确。询问差错时，先指出具体不明之处再请求说明，有助于避免责问语气。涉及欠款时宜明确写出 hutang 或 bayaran，减少与“解释”义的混淆。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 单说 Jelaskannya! 容易像命令或质问。对上级、长辈或客户，可说 Bolehkah tuan/puan menjelaskannya dengan lebih lanjut?；一般请求可加 sila 或 tolong。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: -nya 所指须在上下文中明确。询问差错时，先指出具体不明之处再请求说明，有助于避免责问语气。涉及欠款时宜明确写出 hutang 或 bayaran，减少与“解释”义的混淆。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than a separate borrowing. Jelas expresses clarity and also completion or settlement. The suffix -kan forms a verb meaning to explain or settle, while attached -nya points back to an understood object. The same written form can therefore request an explanation or settlement, with the surrounding conversation supplying both its object and intended meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jelas＝清楚／结清，-kan＝使之如此，-nya＝前面说的“它”：把它讲清，或把它结清。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语 jetty 的整词借入；e 读 /e/。输入包将其拆为 jet 的分析不成立，末尾 i 不是马来语后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 从岸边伸入海中或河中的码头建筑，供船只停靠及人员上下船。

senses.nuances: 着重指伸入水面的实体建筑，而非整个港口；pelabuhan 的范围通常更大。这里的英语对应词 jetty 采用停靠码头义，不自动包含英语中的所有防波堤义。释义依据：[DBP PRPM：jeti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=jeti)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性的标准名词，适用于告示、旅游咨询和日常交流；向工作人员问路可说：Maaf, di manakah jeti penumpang?
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 约定见面时最好说明码头名称和具体入口；大型码头可能有多个上下船位置。正式文件使用 di jeti，熟人聊天可用 kat jeti。

etymology.historical_story: Malay jeti was borrowed as a whole from English jetty. Its spelling follows Malay conventions while retaining the familiar two-syllable shape. The useful cultural image is a landing place reaching out from land towards boats: a meeting point between shore travel and water travel. It is not a Malay derivative of jet. [Lexical source](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Malay/meaning/j/je/jeti.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jeti 与英语 jetty 音形接近：想象一条伸进水里的小码头。整词记忆，不拆成 jet + i。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不变；-nya 读 /ɲa/，可承担强调、名词化或指代功能，须结合句法判断。数据包的 جوجور 是词根 jujur 的拼写，保留原值；完整词形的常规拼写为 جوجورڽ。音节字段按数据包保留 null，实际可分 ju.jur.nya。

senses.zh_definition: 坦白说；说实话。用于引出说话者真实的判断或感受。
senses.en_definition: Honestly; to be frank; introducing the speaker's candid opinion or admission.
senses.ms_definition: Secara terus terang atau dengan ikhlas ketika menyatakan pendapat atau perasaan sebenar.
senses.nuances: 常作句首话语标记，可接逗号；不必然表示先前说过谎。郑重表达也可用 sejujurnya 或 secara jujur。此处是组合词形的用法说明；DBP 对词根的释义见 [PRPM：jujur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=jujur)。

collocations.en: frankly, I do not quite agree

senses.zh_definition: 真诚的；诚实的。用于带有感叹或程度强调的结构。
senses.en_definition: Honest or sincere, with exclamatory emphasis.
senses.ms_definition: Lurus hati atau ikhlas, dengan penegasan terhadap sifat tersebut dalam ungkapan seruan.
senses.nuances: 如 betapa jujurnya 表示“多么真诚”，不是“坦白说”。-nya 的功能取决于整个结构，不能一律译作“他的”。相关功能区别见 [DBP：kata penekan 与 kata pembenda](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/)。

senses.zh_definition: 诚实或真诚这一性质；具体指谁的诚实，由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: The quality of being honest or sincere, with its possessor determined by context.
senses.ms_definition: Sifat jujur seseorang yang dibendakan dalam ayat; kejujuran.
senses.nuances: 是依句法形成的名词化读法，较具文学色彩；一般说明文用 kejujuran 更清楚。不能把所有 jujurnya 都解释为名词。名词化机制参见 [DBP：kata pembenda](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/)。

collocations.en: the sincerity of that person's speech

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合坦承感受或表达真实判断。正式报告可用 secara jujur，正式发言可用 sejujurnya；不要用“说实话”作为羞辱他人的开场。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 提出异议时，jujurnya 后接 saya kurang bersetuju 比直接否定对方柔和；坦率仍需顾及语气与身份关系。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合坦承感受或表达真实判断。正式报告可用 secara jujur，正式发言可用 sejujurnya；不要用“说实话”作为羞辱他人的开场。

etymology.historical_story: Jujurnya illustrates how Malay builds conversational expressions from ordinary descriptive words. The base jujur describes honesty or sincerity, while attached -nya serves several grammatical functions. In modern conversation, the combination can introduce a candid admission. Its history should therefore be understood through Malay word formation, without inventing a separate foreign origin for the whole expression.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 jujur＝诚实；jujurnya 放在句首，就像举起“说实话”的小牌子。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留资料包的词根标记；从形成方式看属于 jeneral 的缩略形式。j 读 /dʒ/，é 读 /e/。word_family 中的 jeneral 是展开形式，不是加词缀形成的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: jeneral 的缩略形式，指将军军衔；《马来大词典》第四版将此小写词条标为印尼用法。
senses.en_definition: A shortened form of jeneral, meaning general as a military rank; labelled Indonesian in Kamus Dewan.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bagi jeneral, dengan label penggunaan Indonesia dalam Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat.
senses.nuances: 须区分词典中的小写 jen 与马来西亚军衔名称前使用的书面缩写 Jen。后者可见于 Jen、Lt Jen、Mej Jen 等形式；口头通常读出完整军衔。[DBP PRPM：jen](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=jen) 标注 Id；马来西亚官方军方文件亦使用 [Mej Jen 与 Brig Jen](https://www.airforce.mil.my/phocadownloadpap/ARKIB_BERITA/2016/9.SEPT/27%20September%202016-17%20ORANG%20PEGAWAI%20KANAN%20TUDM%20MENERIMA%20KENAIKAN%20PANGKAT.pdf)。以下搭配展示军衔缩写，不能据此省略其前面的军衔成分。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Singkatan “jen” merujuk kepada jeneral, manakala bentuk “Jen” digunakan sebelum nama pegawai dalam penulisan tertentu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 缩略形式“jen”指 jeneral，而“Jen”在某些书面格式中用于军官姓名之前。
dual_scenarios.en: The shortened form “jen” refers to jeneral, while “Jen” appears before officers' names in certain written formats.

je 对应 sahaja，带解释或淡化语气。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 军衔关系到正式身份与礼仪。称呼本人或主持正式活动时，应使用准确的完整军衔及适当尊称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 军衔缩写适用于规定采用缩写的名单、报道或内部文件。不要把 Lt Jen、Mej Jen 等不同军衔统一简化成 Jen；保留来源要求的大小写和完整组合。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 军衔关系到正式身份与礼仪。称呼本人或主持正式活动时，应使用准确的完整军衔及适当尊称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 军衔缩写适用于规定采用缩写的名单、报道或内部文件。不要把 Lt Jen、Mej Jen 等不同军衔统一简化成 Jen；保留来源要求的大小写和完整组合。

etymology.historical_story: Jen is formed by shortening jeneral rather than by adding a Malay affix. Kamus Dewan labels the lowercase entry Indonesian. Malaysian military writing also uses capitalized Jen within rank abbreviations. This distinction shows how a dictionary headword and an institutional writing convention can share letters while requiring different explanations of register and use.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 jen，就把 jeneral 的后半段补回来；遇到 Lt Jen 或 Mej Jen，连前面的缩写一起展开。

morphology.formula: ∅ + jade → jade；标准马来语对应形式：jed
morphology.pattern_note: jade 是英语拼写，按英语读作一个音节；标准马来语 jed 读作 /dʒed/。整词记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分。

senses.zh_definition: 玉；用于雕刻和制作首饰的坚韧石材，主要包括硬玉和软玉，常见绿色，也有其他颜色。标准马来语写作 jed。
senses.en_definition: Jade: a tough ornamental material, principally jadeite or nephrite, used for jewellery and carving; standard Malay jed.
senses.ms_definition: Batu bernilai, biasanya berwarna hijau, yang digunakan untuk membuat perhiasan dan barang kemas; istilah bahasa Melayu bakunya ialah jed.
senses.nuances: 本条保留输入词形 jade，但它是英语形式，不能据此认定为马来语规范拼写。马来语正文应使用 jed；jade 可出现在英语标签、商品名称或语码转换中。数据包没有提供 jade 的音节划分或爪夷文，故保留空值。参见 [DBP：jed](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=jed)。

etymology.historical_story: The English name jade traces back to a Spanish expression referring to the flank. Spanish observers associated the stone with an Indigenous American belief that it relieved pain there. Its name therefore carries a medical belief, while its carving traditions extend far beyond Europe. Standard Malay uses jed. [GIA: Jade History and Lore](https://www.gia.edu/jade-history-lore?wm=8001)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到商品标签 jade，就想到“玉”；写马来语时，把英语拼写换成短短的 jed。

etymology.historical_story: Janet developed as a diminutive of Jane and later became an independent given name. The ending belongs to the name's European history, rather than to Malay word formation. etymology.historical_story: English jaeger comes from German Jäger, meaning hunter. Its meanings connect human hunting with seabirds that pursue other birds and seize their food. The same historical word also appears in military terminology. These foreign meanings do not establish when, or whether, jaeger became a standardized Malay borrowing. [Source](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/jaeger).

etymology.historical_story: Jati carries two distinct dictionary identities: genuineness and the teak tree. An early Malay language manual discusses the tree name among Sanskrit plant borrowings, comparing Malay teak with a Sanskrit jasmine name. That historical comparison illustrates how borrowed plant names can change reference; it does not establish that the modern adjective developed from the timber sense. [Historical manual](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/25604/pg25604-images.html)

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates how a national dictionary can preserve regional vocabulary. Kamus Dewan labels jab as Johor usage, while DBP's dialect glossary records the related expression jap ati for firmness of heart or mind. Those records establish regional meaning and pronunciation, but they do not establish an earlier source language or a date of origin. etymology.historical_story: Military titles reveal how neighbouring languages adapt international vocabulary differently. Malaysian Malay uses jeneral, which DBP discusses alongside English general as an example of spelling adaptation. Indonesian uses jenderal, while jendral represents a shortened, nonstandard spelling. These correspondences help readers recognise the title across borders, but they do not establish a precise historical borrowing route for the supplied spelling. See [DBP’s spelling discussion](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2024/09/01/14924/).

etymology.historical_story: Jantina combines parts of jantan and betina, bringing male and female reference into one compact noun. Malay linguistic teaching treats such formations as acronyms or blends rather than ordinary affixation. Its structure offers a useful contrast: the resulting word can itself become the base for derivatives such as kejantinaan. [Malay linguistic source, NIE repository](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/d6cbf620-dfa5-4ac8-8508-9e20152aca56/content)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve a striking cluster of meanings for jaguh: a rooster, an election candidate, and an outstanding performer. Contemporary sports language makes the last meaning especially visible. A crowing rooster offers a memorable image of prominence, but that image is a teaching analogy, not evidence establishing the historical direction of semantic change. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=jaguh)

etymology.historical_story: Malay jimat links careful spending with the wider habit of avoiding waste. Its derivatives connect household budgeting, water conservation, and efficient work through one familiar root. Adding -kan makes a transitive form used in instructions such as jimatkan air. This thrift sense should be distinguished from the separate dictionary entry jimat meaning an amulet.

etymology.historical_story: Jenkins is a surname derived from Jenkin, a diminutive associated with the name John. Its software use has a separate documented history: in January 2011, the Hudson community voted to rename its project Jenkins. Malay technical writing retains that project name unchanged, illustrating how a personal name can also function as a software identifier. [Surname history](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/jenkins); [project announcement](https://www.jenkins.io/blog/2011/01/29/jenkins/).

senses.zh_definition: 朝鲜王朝；1392年建立、1897年改称大韩帝国的朝鲜半岛王朝国家。
senses.en_definition: Joseon, the Korean dynastic state founded in 1392 and proclaimed the Korean Empire in 1897.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi kerajaan beraja di Semenanjung Korea yang diasaskan pada tahun 1392 dan diisytiharkan sebagai Empayar Korea pada tahun 1897.

senses.zh_definition: 朝鲜；在韩语历史名称及特定现代命名语境中对朝鲜或朝鲜半岛的称呼。
senses.en_definition: A Korean name for Korea, used in historical naming and certain modern Korean-language contexts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama Korea dalam bahasa Korea yang digunakan dalam konteks sejarah dan penamaan tertentu pada zaman moden.
senses.nuances: 须结合语境区分朝鲜王朝、古朝鲜及现代朝鲜名称，不能见到 Joseon 就自动译为现代朝鲜民主主义人民共和国。Gojoseon 指古朝鲜。该名称的历史沿用参见 [韩国民族文化大百科全书](https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0051904)。以下为名称说明搭配，使用频率低于 Dinasti Joseon。

etymology.historical_story: Joseon represents Korean 조선, written 朝鮮 in Chinese characters. The dynasty founded by Yi Seong-gye in 1392 revived an older name associated with Gojoseon. That choice linked a new ruling house to an ancient past. The kingdom became the Korean Empire in 1897, although the royal line continued until 1910. See [the Academy of Korean Studies](https://encykorea.aks.ac.kr/Article/E0051904).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Joseon、조선、朝鮮并排记成同一个名字；看到 zaman Joseon，就想到韩剧里的朝鲜王朝时代。

etymology.historical_story: Jonah comes from the Hebrew name Yonah, meaning dove. Its cultural prominence is linked to the biblical prophet whose story involves a sea voyage, a great fish, and a mission to Nineveh. That background explains the name’s associations; it does not establish jonah as a Malay common word. See [Chabad’s account of the name](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/1702445/jewish/What-Does-the-Name-Jonah-Mean.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语读音近“乔纳”：把它先记成一个人的名字。词源可联想“鸽子”，但不要把 Jonah 当作马来语“鸽子”。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -i 接在词根末尾 a 后，规范慢读保留 /a.i/ 两个元音音节。原包的 جومڤا 是词根 jumpa 的 Jawi，派生词按构词拼写校正为 جومڤاءي。主动陈述通常用 menjumpai。

senses.zh_definition: 找到、发现或碰见某个人或事物。
senses.en_definition: To find, discover or encounter someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Mendapati atau menemui seseorang atau sesuatu, sama ada melalui pencarian atau ketika melakukan kegiatan lain.
senses.nuances: 可接人或物作直接宾语，不必然表示偶然发现；强调偶然性时用 terjumpa。jumpai 适用于特定无 meN- 结构，如 Benda itu saya jumpai di pantai；普通主动句用 menjumpai。参见 [DBP：jumpa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=jumpa)。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary family around jumpa distinguishes an encounter, a discovery and a gathering. Terjumpa highlights an accidental encounter, menjumpai expresses finding, and perjumpaan names a meeting. Jumpai belongs to this productive Malay family through the suffix -i. These documented relationships explain its present structure without requiring an unsupported story about its earliest origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=jumpa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 jumpa＝碰见，再把 -i 想成指向宾语的一根手指：jumpai sesuatu，把找到的东西指出来。

etymology.historical_story: The English mineral name jasper belongs to a long naming tradition: earlier French forms connect with Latin iaspis and Greek iaspis. Older usage did not always identify exactly the same material as modern mineral terminology. Malay records jasper as an opaque quartz variety, but the precise route and date of its adoption into Malay remain unverified. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/jasper).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jas-per 想成两块拼合的彩色石头：颜色鲜明，却不透光。抓住“彩色、不透明、石英质”三点；不要记成翡翠。

senses.zh_definition: 隶属同一行政管辖的地区；在吉兰丹行政体系中，指称 jajahan 这一行政单位。

senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan jalan jajahan: jalan kecil atau lorong.

etymology.historical_story: Jajahan belongs to the jajah family, which includes words for conquering, ruling and colonial domination. Its meanings also preserve an administrative sense: territory under one authority. Kelantan still uses jajahan in district administration. This explains why the same word can appear in accounts of colonial rule and in an ordinary local government office name. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=jajah)、[日里行政区署](https://ptjj.kelantan.gov.my/index.php/profail/latar-belakang/pentadbiran-jajahan-dan-daerah)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 jajah“征服并统治”＋-an“相关地区”：jajahan 是管辖的土地；先看语境，再判断是行政区还是殖民地。

morphology.formula: ∅ + jap → jap；口语时间义：sekejap → kejap → jap
morphology.pattern_note: 古义 jap 按独立词素记忆；现代口语中表示“一会儿”的 jap 是 sekejap 或 kejap 的词首截短形式，不是加词缀形成的。词尾 /p/ 常不除阻，读作 [d͡ʒap̚]。下列关联形式仅属于口语时间义，不是古义 jap 的派生词。

word_family.gloss: 一会儿；此处仅指与 jap 对应的口语时间义
片刻；一会儿；口语 jap 对应的完整形式

senses.zh_definition: 【古】完整、完备；编织等紧密无隙；已经合为一体，或已经达成一致。
senses.en_definition: Archaic: complete or sufficient; closely woven or joined; united or in agreement.
senses.ms_definition: Ark: sempurna (cukup), rapat (anyaman dan lain-lain), sudah menjadi satu, sudah sepakat.
senses.nuances: 这是输入材料所载的古义，不应把日常 tunggu jap 中的 jap 解释为“完整”。现代普通交谈中很少主动使用此义；下列为释义性搭配示例，并非已确认的高频搭配。[DBP：jap I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=jap)

collocations.zh: 已经完整；已经合为一体或达成一致

senses.zh_definition: 【口】一会儿，片刻；用于请求别人稍等，或表示某个动作只持续很短时间。
senses.en_definition: Colloquial: for a moment or a short while; also used to ask someone to wait briefly.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk singkat sekejap dalam bahasa basahan, yang bermaksud sebentar atau seketika.
senses.nuances: 常见于即时消息和朋友交谈。单独说 jap 或 jap, jap 可以表示“等一下”。它没有固定的秒数，也不一定承诺马上完成。此义是口语截短形式；headword.status 的 official 不表示这种写法适用于正式公文。[DBP：sekejap及口语缩略说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sekejap)

senses.zh_definition: 【口；毒品语境】把毒品用针注入体内。
senses.en_definition: Colloquial: to inject a drug of abuse into the body.
senses.ms_definition: Bahasa percakapan: menyuntik atau mencucuk jarum yang mengandungi dadah ke dalam tubuh.
senses.nuances: DBP 另列为同形词 jap II。此义涉及注射毒品，不能据此将 jap 当作普通医疗“打针”的通用标准词。下列为帮助辨义的组合，不声称具有高频地位。[DBP：jap II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=jap)

etymology.historical_story: One spelling brings together distinct lexical histories. Kamus Dewan records an archaic jap describing completeness, close joining, or agreement, and another colloquial jap referring to drug injection. Everyday conversational jap meaning a moment is a shortening of sekejap or kejap. These meanings should be learned separately; their shared spelling does not establish a common historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sekejap 越说越短：sekejap → kejap → jap，连“一会儿”这个词都只说一小截！此口诀只帮助记忆口语时间义。

senses.zh_definition: 杜松；刺柏属（Juniperus）的常绿灌木，其某些种类的浆果状球果可提供芳香油，用于传统药用和杜松子酒调味。
senses.en_definition: An evergreen shrub of the genus Juniperus, some species of which bear aromatic, berry-like cones used for medicinal preparations and flavouring gin.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok renek malar hijau daripada genus Juniperus yang buah berinya menghasilkan minyak yang dapat digunakan dalam ubat dan sebagai perisa dalam gin.
senses.nuances: 马来语释义据Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat展开缩写，词目、音节及爪夷文见[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=370084&keyword=juniper)。IPA为按马来语读音拟写的宽式音标，非DBP提供的转写。日常所谓beri在植物学上是肉质浆果状球果，参见[牛津大学植物资料](https://herbaria.plants.ox.ac.uk/bol/plants400/Profiles/IJ/Juniperus)。本条采用输入的灌木义；科学描述整个属时也包括乔木。排名沿用输入。

etymology.historical_story: English juniper goes back to Latin iuniperus, the name of the tree; the Latin word’s deeper origin is uncertain. Malay records the matching botanical name as juniper. Its aromatic, berry-like cones connect the plant with European cooking and gin production, although the dictionary evidence here does not establish the precise route or date of borrowing into Malay. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/juniper), [Botanical uses](https://herbaria.plants.ox.ac.uk/bol/plants400/Profiles/IJ/Juniperus).

etymology.historical_story: Janice is an English elaboration of Jane. A name reference associates its creation with Paul Leicester Ford's novel Janice Meredith, published in 1899. That literary connection concerns the English name's history. In Malay conversation, Janice functions as a person's name, without acquiring a new meaning through Malay prefixes or suffixes. [Janice: name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/janice)

senses.nuances: 这是 jalan 的道路、路线义加上领属附着语素 -ku，并非独立派生词。常见于 menghalang jalanku 等表达。-ku 与前词连写；正式职场表达通常采用 jalan saya 或 laluan saya。马来语释义为根据词根与附着结构编写的释义。[DBP：ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=ku)。

etymology.historical_story: Jalanku is a transparent Malay construction: jalan followed by the bound first-person form -ku, related to aku. A physical path can also become a personal course through life, giving the expression its reflective force. Its structure remains accessible to present-day speakers; no separate borrowing history is needed to explain the complete form. [DBP: ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=ku).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jalan 是“路”，-ku 是“我的”：jalan + ku，一眼看懂“我的路”。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成名词，词根字母保持不变；词根末尾的 s 在音节划分中成为末音节 san 的声母。这里对应表示直向、趋向的 jurus II。

etymology.historical_story: DBP groups jurusan with jurus II, whose meanings concern straightness and direction. The suffix -an produces a noun covering both a physical direction and a field of study. Thinking of education as choosing a direction helps connect these meanings, although that connection is a learning interpretation rather than a documented chronology of semantic change. [DBP lexical family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menjurus)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jurus 是“朝向”，加 -an 得到 jurusan：道路有方向，读书也有专业方向。

morphology.pattern_note: janji 的发音保持不变，后接 /lah/。-lah 是附着语气词，不是派生词缀；suffix 在此仅表示后接位置。输入的 Jawi جنجي 仅对应 janji，按要求保留；带 -lah 的完整形式为 جنجيله。音节为按构成补出的 jan.ji.lah。

senses.zh_definition: 答应吧；保证吧。用于请求或敦促对方作出承诺，带有强调或恳求语气。

senses.ms_definition: Bentuk janji yang disertai partikel -lah untuk meminta atau menggesa seseorang supaya berjanji.
senses.nuances: 这是依据 janji 与 -lah 的功能综合给出的释义，并非输入中已有的独立 DBP 词条原文。此处 janji 作口语中的承诺动词；正式完整表达通常用 berjanjilah。-lah 可表示恳求、鼓励或敦促，实际力度取决于语调。附着语气词应连写，参见 [DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=lah)。

etymology.historical_story: Janjilah illustrates a grammatical pattern rather than a separate historical borrowing. Malay attaches the particle -lah to a preceding word for emphasis. DBP explicitly distinguishes this particle from a derivational affix. Here it accompanies conversational janji, giving a request for commitment additional interpersonal force; the fuller verbal form is berjanjilah. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=lah).

etymology.historical_story: In his study of Sanskrit vocabulary in Southeast Asian languages, Satya Vrat Shastri connects jelita with Sanskrit lalita, a word associated with beauty, charm and grace. Modern Malay treats jelita as a complete lexical root. Its derivatives kejelitaan and jelitawan show how an established word participates in Malay word formation, while its elevated tone makes it useful in literary descriptions of beauty. [Shastri, Sanskrit Words in Southeast Asian Languages](https://www.wisdomlib.org/history/book/sanskrit-words-in-southeast-asian-languages/d/doc1595656.html)

etymology.historical_story: Jackpot grew out of English poker vocabulary: jack names a playing card, while pot names the pooled stakes. The word became associated with large accumulated winnings and later with the biggest prize in other games. Its figurative extension allows speakers to describe an exceptional stroke of luck even when no gambling occurs. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/jackpot).

etymology.historical_story: JFK comes from the initials of John Fitzgerald Kennedy, whose presidency became associated with the Peace Corps and the American ambition to reach the Moon. The same initials also identify the New York airport bearing his name. In Malay, the surrounding topic therefore matters: history suggests the president, while travel suggests the airport. [National Archives](https://www.archives.gov/presidential-libraries/events/centennials/jfk100/bio); [New York State](https://www.governor.ny.gov/sites/governor.ny.gov/files/atoms/files/JFKVisionPlan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三个字母对应三个名字：John—Fitzgerald—Kennedy；看到 ucapan 想总统，看到 penerbangan 想机场。

etymology.historical_story: English jewel names a precious object and also supplies memorable names for places. A regional example is Jewel Changi Airport, which welcomed the public on 17 April 2019. Its name illustrates how an English word can appear inside Malay conversation as an unchanged proper name, without demonstrating adoption as an ordinary Malay noun. [Changi opening announcement](https://www.changiairport.com/content/dam/jca-project/documents/Media_Release_Jewel_Opening_and_Preview_FINAL.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Jorge belongs to the European naming tradition associated with George. Portuguese reference works trace it to Greek georgos, meaning farmer, and connect its cultural history with Saint George. That agricultural origin explains the name’s background; it does not make Jorge a Malay word for farmer. In Malay writing, the name identifies a person rather than an occupation. [Infopédia](https://www.infopedia.pt/dicionarios/antroponimia/Jorge)

etymology.historical_story: English jasmine entered through French forms ultimately traced through Arabic to Persian. Its history follows a flower name across several languages while preserving a recognisable sound. Malay botanical usage offers another useful perspective: DBP identifies melur with Jasminum sambac and also records jasmin in the term minyak jasmin. These connections aid recognition, but the English spelling does not establish official Malay status. [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/jasmine_1)、[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=jasmin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 /dʒæz-mɪn/ 两拍记 jasmine，联想一杯飘香的茉莉花茶；常见马来语对应名称是 melur、melati。

morphology.pattern_note: 直接加后缀 -kan，词根不变，音节可分析为 ja.ga.kan；常见于祈使句及第一、第二人称被动结构，完整主动式为 menjagakan。headword.jawi 按输入保留词根拼写 جاݢ；派生形式为 جاݢاکن。

senses.zh_definition: 叫醒；使正在睡觉的人醒来。
senses.en_definition: To wake someone from sleep.
senses.ms_definition: Membangunkan seseorang daripada tidur.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 所收 menjagakan 的使动义；jagakan 可用于请求或命令，如 Jagakan saya pukul enam。现代日常表达也常用 bangunkan 或 kejutkan。不要把此义理解为单纯保持清醒；保持清醒通常用 berjaga。[DBP：menjagakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menjagakan)

senses.zh_definition: 替某人照看、看管或照顾人或物。

senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan percakapan, menjaga atau mengawasi seseorang atau sesuatu bagi pihak orang lain.
senses.nuances: 这是根据 jaga 的照看义及 -kan 的受益用法分析的口语用法，并非上引 DBP 条目对 menjagakan 的释义。Tolong jagakan beg saya 中，请求对方替说话者看包；正式写作可用 tolong jaga 或 menjaga ... untuk ...，使意思更明确。

etymology.historical_story: An early Malay-English dictionary records jagakan alongside menjagakan with the meaning of waking a person, while identifying jaga as Sanskrit in origin. Its neighbouring forms connect wakefulness with watchfulness: berjaga means staying awake, and menjaga means watching. This historical grouping offers a useful cultural picture of a watchman staying awake while others sleep. [Historical Malay-English dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/94/An_abridged_Malay-English_dictionary_%28romanized%29_%28IA_afu7967.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jaga 是醒着，-kan 让别人进入这个状态：jagakan = 把人叫醒。想象闹钟喊：醒来，该你 jaga 了！
